name: Blood In The Air
body:
A scarlet death flies on iron wings.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, carnage class feature.

Benefit(s): You may deliver reaping strikes with your flying blades. Additionally, you may treat bladestorm levels as blood knight levels when determining the bonus damage dealt by reaping strikes.
